about: Golden parity file for the TypeScript port of model.js (SIM_VERSION 6). Hour index h counts from GAME_START (2026-11-10T00:00+05:30); the IST clock hour is h % 24. For each scenario: s = createPlant(sp, plantH, owner); then for h = plantH .. endH - 1, s = step(s, { h, wx }, events[h] || [], SPECIES[sp]), where wx = { T, RH, P, SW, ET0, U, Ts, isDay } is index h of weather[weatherKey] (the Open-Meteo row stamped at the END of hour h). Snapshots hold the state returned by step() and toVisual(state, SPECIES[sp]) whenever state.h % 6 === 0 (00, 06, 12 and 18 IST), every hour while hourly[0] <= state.h <= hourly[1] when a scenario has an hourly window (null otherwise; it brackets a bloom moment), plus the state at planting and after the last step. expectBloom holds expectBloom(state, SPECIES[sp], { h: state.h, climT }) at planting and every 24 h. rainSoon holds cases of rainSoon(rows, fromH, hours): rows are { h, wx: { P } } for every hour of weather[weatherKey].P, or the case's own rows; hours is absent when the default is meant; out must match exactly.
rounding: Snapshot and expectBloom numbers that are not integers are stored as Math.round(x * 1000000000) / 1000000000; integers, booleans, strings and string arrays are exact. Weather, climT and constants are stored unrounded (they are inputs). A port passes when every field matches after the same rounding, allowing 1e-9 for a value that straddles a rounding boundary, and when its constants equal the constants block.
